texts.name: Rent Receipt
texts.text:
Dear Marvin Coaker,

We have received your rent payment for the month of August.

This emails serves as a receipt for your payment(s) received. Please refer to the file attached for details.

Thank you for your payment!

If you have any questions or need further assistance, please feel free to reach out.

Best regards,

texts.name: Meeting No Show
texts.text:
Hey [[TO=firstname]] [[SCRIPT=GoodMorning|lower]],

I didn't see you join the meeting today. We typically wait about 10 minutes as our standard practice before canceling the meeting and then attempting to reschedule.[[CURSOR]]

I understand that sometimes things come up, would you like to reschedule our meeting?
  • If so, what time works best for you?
Thanks and looking forward to hearing from you soon,[[SCRIPT=SetSubject|UpHill Solutions / [[INPUT=Meeting With|select|[[SCRIPT=GetClientList]]]] - Do We Need to Reschedule our Meeting Today?]]

texts.name: Cease and Desist
texts.text:
Dear [[TO=fullname]],

This email serves as formal notice that your [[INPUT=HarassmentType|select|unsolicited business proposals;unauthorized solicitations]] are unwelcome, unwanted, and unwarranted. You are hereby required to cease and desist all further contact, including but not limited to emails.

If you fail to comply and continue to send unsolicited communications, a lawsuit will be commenced against you seeking monetary damages and all available legal remedies.

To avoid further escalation, you must provide written assurance by [[SCRIPT=DateOffset|0|5|numeric]], confirming that you will refrain from any further contact. Failure to do so will result in the initiation of legal proceedings in the appropriate jurisdiction.

This will serve as your final warning.

Sincerely,

Robert Hill
